questions: Do you have a tremor in your hands, especially when they are at rest?
Do you feel that your movements have become slow or that your body feels stiff?
Do you have trouble with your balance, such as falling backward or having difficulty turning around?
Have you noticed any changes in your memory or thinking abilities recently?
Have you had any unexplained falls recently?
Have you noticed any changes in your handwriting or that it has become smaller?
Do you have any problems with controlling your bladder?
Have other people commented that you seem less interested in activities you used to enjoy?
Do you have any difficulty looking up or down, especially when walking down stairs or reading?
Do you feel like your neck is stiff or pulls backward?
Have you had any episodes of falling backward specifically?
Do you find yourself having exaggerated emotional expressions, like laughing or crying more than usual?
When you walk, do you feel like you might fall backward or need to catch yourself?
Do your feet ever feel like they are stuck to the floor when you try to start walking?
Do you tend to take small, shuffling steps when you walk?
Do you have difficulty making turns, especially in tight spaces?
Do you freeze or stop suddenly when walking through doorways or narrow passages?
Do you lean forward when you walk, as if rushing to catch your balance?
Do you sometimes feel unsteady or off-balance even though you can still walk normally?
When someone pulls you backward unexpectedly, do you feel like you might fall?
Have you ever fallen backward unexpectedly?
Do you sometimes feel like you are "falling backward" in your chair?
Have other people mentioned that you seem unsteady or fragile?
orders: Orthostatic vital signs (blood pressure and heart rate lying and standing)
Formal examination of extraocular movements, specifically testing vertical gaze (up and down pursuit and saccades)
Assessment of gag reflex and speech clarity
Detailed neurological examination focusing on axial tone (neck and trunk rigidity) and limb tone
Gait assessment including assessment of stride length, arm swing, and turning
Brain MRI to evaluate for structural causes
served: observation for excessive slowness or uneconomic posture
